subject: Consolidated half-day enablement — split US/APAC windows & ops contingency
messages:
From: Leah Turner <l.turner@aurorahealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: platform@aurorahealth.com
Date: Sun, 05 May 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora — half-day enablement request (US/APAC attendees)

Hi Olga and Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move to a hands-on half-day enablement so our Platform & Integrations teams can pair with your engineers. We have a mixed audience across US (PST) and APAC (IST/Singapore), and a single continuous block will be hard for everyone to attend.

Can Redwood run a split half-day where:
- Block A (US-first): 2.5 hours focused on Console walkthrough + sandbox API quickstart
- Break / overlap: 30 minutes for break and cross-team Q&A
- Block B (APAC-focused): 2 hours focused on deeper API integration patterns and runbook handoff

Ideal week: May 13–17. Preference for May 15 if possible.

We also have a security micro-review requirement: confirm that session recordings and logs remain in our tenant and that no customer data will be uploaded to Redwood-hosted demos.

Can you propose slot times (PST/SGT) and who from Redwood will lead each block?

Thanks,
Leah
Leah Turner
Head of Platform Engineering
Aurora Health
Attachments: none
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Leah Turner <l.turner@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 May 2029 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora — half-day enablement request (US/APAC attendees)

Hi Leah — great to hear you're ready to move forward. We can run the split half-day on Wednesday, May 15. Proposed windows below (local times included):

Option (preferred):
- Block A (US-first): 09:00–11:30 PST (Console walkthrough, sandbox hands-on, 2.5h)
- Overlap/break: 11:30–12:00 PST (30m)
- Block B (APAC): 13:00–15:00 SGT (11:00–13:00 PST equivalent, 2h)

Operational notes:
- We'll run Block A from Redwood-hosted sandboxes in your VPC/Private deployment mode so no Aurora customer data leaves your environment.
- We'll record the session into your tenant S3 bucket per your security ask and will not persist any demo artifacts in Redwood's hosted buckets.

Leads:
- Block A (Console + sandbox quickstart): Jasmine Liu (Product Enablement) and Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer)
- Block B (API integration + runbook): Ben Carter lead; Jasmine on API deep-dive as overlap support

I've attached our onboarding runbook draft and an access checklist. Can you confirm:
1) May 15 works for your team?
2) Who will own the tenant/S3 path for the recording?
3) Any additional attendees (security/audit) we should loop in?

I'll tentatively hold the times and send calendar invites once you confirm.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: aurora-onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 254 KB); access-prereqs-checklist.csv (CSV, 4 KB)
From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 06 May 2029 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal — who takes which block on May 15?

Ben / Jasmine — quick internal split so we have ops continuity and a fallback:

Plan:
- Ben: own Block B and the API deep-dive. Prepare the integration runbook sections (Auth, KV cache, batching recommendations) by May 10.
- Jasmine: lead Block A console walkthrough and the sandbox demo script. Prep a 45-min lab with checkpoints.
- Marissa: I'll ask you to be on the invite as backup owner for runbook escalation and to handle any contractual/credits questions should they arise during the session.

Contingency (if Ben is pulled into a customer escalations):
- Olga steps into Block B for the first hour and hands off to Jasmine for overlap portion; record all session markers in the runbook.

Attachments referenced in thread: aurora-onboarding-runbook-v1.pdf, access-prereqs-checklist.csv

Thanks — please confirm on this thread so I can finalize the invite and the runbook link to share with Aurora.
From: Leah Turner <l.turner@aurorahealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: platform@aurorahealth.com, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 May 2029 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora — half-day enablement request (US/APAC attendees)

Thanks, Olga — May 15 works. Confirming:
- Recording will be written to our tenant S3 path (s3://aurora-platform/onboarding/2029-05-15/) — I'll give you write access to a temp folder by EOD May 10.
- Security will attend the first 30 minutes of Block A for the micro-review and then join the overlap for Q&A.
- Attendee list: Platform eng (Leah, Carl), Integrations (Maya), Security (Lena) — I'll share a final roster by May 12.

Ben/Jasmine — sounds good on the split leads. If Ben is pulled, Olga's contingency plan is acceptable.

Please send invites with both PST and SGT times and include the runbook link. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Leah
--- End of thread ---
